questions.stem: What is the role of FSH at the start of the menstrual cycle?

options.text: It causes the uterus lining to break down
It stimulates a follicle to develop in the ovary and produce oestrogen

questions.explanation: FSH (follicle stimulating hormone) is released from the pituitary gland at the start of the cycle. It causes a follicle to mature in the ovary and stimulates the follicle to produce oestrogen.
